title: Self-adjoint discrete interfaces for coupling finite elements with neural operators: an exact energy-matching criterion
description:
Reference implementation for the manuscript: the two- and three-dimensional coupled finite-element / neural-operator solvers, the interface-transfer audit, the strong-form baselines, the operator-learning surrogates, the scripts that regenerate every table and figure, and the auditors used to check the manuscript.

The manuscript states the bounds of its own claims: the energy-matching law is proved for the series idealisation, the consistency proposition establishes consistency rather than an a priori bound, and the reported convergence rates are measured rather than derived.
